comparisons.peer_summary: On August 17, 2024, AMD agreed to acquire ZT Systems for approximately $3.4 billion in cash and stock, with potential additional payments of $300 million and up to 740,964 shares, expected to close in the first half of fiscal year 2025 subject to regulatory approvals.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclosed significant M&A activities in 2024 to expand their technology portfolios, though the specific targets and financial structures differed. AVGO acquired Seagate's SoC operations for a fixed $600 million in cash to gain SoC design and manufacturing capabilities. In contrast, AMD agreed to acquire ZT Systems for a larger approximately $3.4 billion in cash and stock to extend data center infrastructure capabilities. Both transactions were strategic acquisitions aimed at broadening hardware and system-level capabilities, but AVGO's was a smaller, asset-focused buy, while AMD's was a larger entity acquisition with contingent value rights.

sentences.text: On April 23, 2024, we acquired certain assets related to the design, development, and manufacture of System-on-Chip ("SoC") operations of Seagate Technology Holdings plc for $600 million.
On August 17, 2024, we agreed to acquire ZT Systems.

Upon closing of the acquisition, we will pay approximately $3.4 billion in cash and 8,335,852 shares of AMD common stock and to the extent certain conditions are met, we will pay an additional $300 million of cash and up to 740,964 shares of AMD common stock.
